title: LLETZ Under Direct Colposcopic Vision
brief_summary: To assess the benefits of large Loop excision of the transformation Zone (LLETZ) under direct colposcopic Vision.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* histologically proven cervical dysplasia
* colposcopy Prior to conization
* informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* significant language barrier
* a personal history of conization
* pregnancy
* the use of blood thinner
* unwillingness to participate
